Stores indoor MQTT readings in SQLite and presents current and 24-hour history views.

label: Optional OpenWeather
info: Disabled by default. Add your own OpenWeather API key and coordinates in the function node, then enable this tab. Never commit configured credentials or coordinates.

sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_readings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL, sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL, temperature_f REAL, humidity_percent REAL)
name: Create sensor_readings table

sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS weather_readings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL, temperature_f REAL, humidity_percent REAL, description TEXT)
name: Create weather_readings table

sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sensor_readings_time ON sensor_readings(recorded_at)
name: Create reading-time index

sql: SELECT recorded_at, sensor_id, location, temperature_f, humidity_percent FROM sensor_readings WHERE recorded_at >= datetime('now', '-24 hours') ORDER BY recorded_at ASC
name: Load previous 24 hours
